86000.commentary: (NPt) piṭakānaṃ atthakathanaṃ peṭakaṃ, so eva upadeso'ti peṭakopadeso, upadesabhūtā pariyattisaṃvaṇṇanā'ti attho.

86002.meaning1: Book 21 of the Khuddaka Nikāya; Peṭakopadesa

examples.text: nīvaraṇāni hi jhān'aṅga-paccanīkāni, tesaṃ jhān'aṅgān'eva paṭipakkhāni, viddhaṃsakānī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tathā hi samādhi kāmacchandassa paṭipakkho, pīti byāpādassa, vitakko thinamiddhassa, sukhaṃ uddhaccakukkuccassa, vicāro vicikicchāyā'ti peṭake vuttaṃ.

86004.grammar: fem, loc sg of bhū, irreg form of bhuyaṃ
86004.meaning1: in the earth; on the ground

examples.text: loluppacārañ'ca pahāya tasmā, okkhittacakkhu yugamattadassī, ākaṅkhamāno bhuvi sericāraṃ, careyya dhīro sapadānacāran'ti.

86005.meaning1: having severed; having cut off; having completely stopped

examples.text: rājā aññe'pi dvattiṃsa bhikkhū tumhehi saddhiṃ sve bhikkhaṃ gaṇhantū'ti eten'eva upāyena divase divase vaḍḍhāpento saṭṭhisahassānaṃ brāhmaṇaparibbājak'ādīnaṃ bhattaṃ upacchinditvā antonivesane saṭṭhisahassānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ niccabhattaṃ paṭṭhapesi nigrodhatthere gaten'eva pasādena.
milindo nāma so rājā, sāgalāyaṃ pur'uttame, upagañchi nāgasenaṃ, gaṅgā ca yathā sāgaraṃ.

86007.meaning1: to object; to reject; to refuse; to oppose

examples.text: sace pana saṅghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā anāmasitvā idaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ cetiyassa dema, vihārassa dema, navakammassa demā'ti vadanti, paṭikkhipituṃ na vaṭṭati. ime idaṃ bhaṇantī'ti kappiyakārakānaṃ ācikkhitabbaṃ.

86008.commentary: (DNt) piṇḍ'attho nāma vippakiṇṇassa atthassa suvijānan'atthaṃ sampiṇḍetvā kathanaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ pana piṇḍ'attho. yasmā assa odhi cattaṃ hoti paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, tasmā taṃ paccavekkhitvā ca laddhasomanasso tat'uttaripi so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedan'ti yathāpāḷi netabbaṃ.

86009.meaning1: fact of having intended; fact of having willed
86009.construction:
saṃ + cetaya + ita + tta
sañcetayita + tta

examples.text: katamā tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti? yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātusamphassajā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ, ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti.

86010.meaning1: name of a vinayadhara monk in Sri Lanka; Mahāsuma the elder

examples.text: tesu mahāsumatthero nakkhattuṃ vinayapiṭakaṃ assosi, mahāpadumatthero tena saddhiṃ navakkhattuṃ, visuñ'ca ekako'va navakkhattun'ti aṭṭhārasakkhattuṃ assosi, ayam'eva tesu byattataro.

86011.meaning1: should be taken; should be accepted

examples.text: tattha na āsane nisīditabban'ti idha, bhante, nisīdathā'ti vuttenā'pi na nisīditabbaṃ. na āmisaṃ paṭiggahetabban'ti yāgukhajjak'ādibhedaṃ kiñci āmisaṃ gaṇhatha, bhante'ti yāciyamānenā'pi na gaṇhitabbaṃ.

86012.meaning1: should be undertaken; should be practised

examples.text: tasmā evarūpam'pi vattaṃ na kātabbaṃ. imaṃ temāsaṃ sabbeh'eva na uddisitabbaṃ, na paripucchitabbaṃ, na pabbājetabbaṃ, mūgabbataṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ, bahi sīmaṭṭhassā'pi saṅghalābho dātabbo'ti evam'ādikaṃ pana na kātabbam'eva.
tikkhattuṃ yācāpetvā tadanurūpāya kammavācāya parivāso dātabbo.

86014.meaning1: with bow in hand; armed with a bow

examples.text: ārūḷhā gāmaṇīyehi, cāpahatthehi vammibhi, parivāressant'imaṃ niccaṃ, ratnapīṭhass'idaṃ phalaṃ.

86017.meaning1: to indicate; to point out; to refer (to)

examples.text: tattha tattha yojetvā suttassa attho niddisitabbo. na hi sati vedanā mano dhāretvā sakkā yena kenaci suttassa attho yathābhūtaṃ niddisituṃ.
saṃsāmetvā'ti suguttaṃ katvā. vajjī'ti evaṃnāmako janapado, vajjī nāma jānapadino rājakumārā, tesaṃ nivāso eko'pi janapado ruḷhīvasena vajjī-tv'eva vuccati. tena vuttaṃ vajjīsū'ti.

86019.construction:
√ruh + ta + ī
rūḍha + ī > ruḍhī > ruḷhī

examples.text: kurūsu viharatī'ti kurū nāma jānapadino rājakumārā, tesaṃ nivāso eko'pi janapado ruḷhīsaddena kurū'ti vuccati. tasmiṃ kurūsu janapade.

86020.meaning1: conventional meaning; common language; customary usage

examples.text: cāpālaṃ cetiyan'ti pubbe cāpālassa nāma yakkhassa vasitaṭṭhānaṃ cāpālacetiyan'ti paññāyittha. tattha bhagavato katavihāro'pi tāya ruḷhiyā cāpālacetiyan'ti vuccati.
tattha na te pīṭham'adāyimhā'ti pīṭham'pi te na dāpayimha.

86022.synonym: uttānīkaroti, upadasseti, jotayati, jotāpeti, joteti, dīpayati, dīpeti, pakāsayati, pakāseti

examples.text: desanāsāsanakathā, bhedaṃ tesu yath'ārahaṃ, sikkhāpahānagambhīra, bhāvañ'ca paridīpaye.

86023.meaning1: having had (something) appraised; having got valued; having had a price put on

examples.text: agghāpetvā vātajavaṃ, sindhavaṃ sīghavāhanaṃ, padum'uttarabuddhassa, khamanīyam'adās'ahaṃ.
tato pubbe pana bodhisatto asse agghāpetvā mūlaṃ aparihāpetvā dāpesi.

86024.meaning1: to bear fruit; to give consequential results

examples.text: tadetaṃ kusalapakkhe mahaggatakammaṃ, akusalapakkhe pañc'ānantariyakammaṃ veditabbaṃ. tasmiṃ sati sesāni kusalāni vā akusalāni vā vipaccituṃ na sakkonti, tadeva duvidham'pi paṭisandhiṃ deti.
dvayaṃ pādagaṇṭhimhi. gupa rakkhaṇe pho, sakatthe ko. pādassa gaṇṭhi pādagaṇṭhi.

yā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññā-āloko paññā-obhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi, tāya paññāya samannāgatattā dhīrā.

86027.meaning1: having received higher ordination as monastic

examples.text: ekasmiñ'hi sāvatthito avidūre nigamagāme jātasaṃvaḍḍho eko kulaputto satthu sāsane pabbajitvā laddh'ūpasampado nigamavāsitissatthero nāma app'iccho santuṭṭho pavivitto āraddhavīriyo'ti paññāyi. so nibaddhaṃ ñātigāme'y'eva piṇḍāya vicarati.

86028.synonym: uttānīkaroti, upadasseti, jotayati, jotāpeti, joteti, pakāsayati, pakāseti, paridīpayati

examples.text: sassato loko, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti yathā jāneyya, tathā vadeyya katheyya bhaṇeyya dīpayeyya vohareyya..
anudeva [anva'd'eva, sy'ādikaṇḍe (moggallāne) 11 suttaṃ passitabbaṃ]

86030.meaning1: having become sick (of); having become fed up (with); having become annoyed (with)

examples.text: vassasatassa vassasatassā'ti kasmā evaṃ cintesi? tesaṃ saddena ukkaṇṭhitvā, samāpannassa saddo kaṇṭako'ti hi vuttaṃ. tasmā saddena ukkaṇṭhito mahāpuriso.

āvatto bāhullāyā'ti rasagiddho hutvā paṇītapiṇḍapāt'ādīnaṃ atthāya āvatto. nibbijja pakkamiṃsū'ti ukkaṇṭhitvā dhammaniyāmen'eva pakkantā bodhisattassa sambodhiṃ pattakāle kāyavivekassa okāsadānatthaṃ dhammatāya gatā. gacchantā ca aññaṭṭhānaṃ agantvā bārāṇasim'eva agamaṃsu.

86031.synonym: chamā, paṭhavī, pathavī, bhū, bhūma, bhūmi, bhūri
86031.notes: A commentarial term, mostly used in an effort to explain words with ku-.

examples.text: kuñjarenā'ti kuṃ pathaviṃ jīrayati, kuñjesu vā ramati caratī'ti kuñjaro'ti laddhanāmena hatthinā.
upādānan'ti daḷhaggahaṇaṃ vuccati. daḷh'attho hi ettha upasaddo, upāyāsa upakaṭṭhā'ti-ādīsu viya pañcakāmaguṇikarāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.

86033.synonym: upaparikkhati, upavicarati, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, pavicinati, vicāreti, vīmaṃsati, samannesati, samanvesati
86033.commentary: (NPa) kiṃ vicinatī'ti ettha vicinatī'ti etena vicayasaddassa kattuniddesataṃ dasseti.

examples.text: kiṃ vicinati? padaṃ vicinati, pañhaṃ vicinati, visajjanaṃ vicinati, pubbāparaṃ vicinati, assādaṃ vicinati, ādīnavaṃ vicinati, nissaraṇaṃ vicinati, phalaṃ vicinati, upāyaṃ vicinati, āṇattiṃ vicinati, anugītiṃ vicinati, sabbe nava sutt'ante vicinati.
pavicinatī'ti-ādi sabbaṃ tattha ñāṇacāravaseneva vuttaṃ. atha vā pavicinatī'ti tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ vicinati.

86034.meaning1: name of a town in Myanmar; Pagan

examples.text: idañ'ca lakkhaṇaṃ purimanaye'pi veditabbaṃ. ayaṃ pana viseso, tatra ukkhipāpetvā kātuṃ na vaṭṭati, hatthapāsam'eva ānetabbo.

86037.meaning1: having become bound; having become tied up; having become caught up (by)

examples.text: opātass'eva pana anulomesu pās'ādīsu'pi yo tāva pāsaṃ oḍḍeti ettha bajjhitvā sattā marissantī'ti avassaṃ bajjhanakasattānaṃ vasena hatthā muttamatte pārājik'ānantariya-thullaccaya-pācittiyāni veditabbāni.

86038.commentary: (PMa) paṇidhiyā muccatī'ti paṇidhito muccati. paṇidhi muccatī'ti pāṭho nissakk'attho'y'eva.
86038.notes: The feminine is only found in later literature.

examples.text: visamāya patthanāya hetu visamaṃ na careyya, visamāya paṇidhiyā hetu visamaṃ na careyya na ācareyya na samācareyya na samādāya vatteyyāti, na tassa hetū visamaṃ careyya.
dukkhato manasikaronto paṇidhiyā muccatī'ti, appaṇihito vimokkho. yattha na paṇidahati, tena suñño'ti, suññato vimokkho.
ekavaṇṇasuttena pan'ettha yena kenaci sibbituṃ vaṭṭati.

so kira tadā manussānaṃ dassanaṭṭhāne bhikkhū ākāse gacchante viya, ṭhite viya pallaṅkena nisinne viya, ākāse sūcikammaṃ karonte viya, potthakaṃ vācente viya, ākāse cīvaraṃ pasāretvā kāyaṃ utuṃ gaṇhāpente viya, navapabbajite ākāsena carante viya, taruṇasāmaṇere ākāse ṭhatvā pupphāni ocinante viya katvā dassesi.

kiṃkāraṇā patilīnacarā vuccanti satta sekkhā? te tato tato cittaṃ patilīnentā patikuṭentā pativaṭṭentā sannirumbhentā sanniggaṇhantā sannivārentā rakkhantā gopentā caranti vicaranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpenti

86042.meaningLit: having caused to obstruct down together
86042.commentary: (VINt) sannirumbhitvā aṭṭhāsī'ti tassa sīse daṇḍassa ṭhapitabhāvaṃ apassanto tattha daṇḍaṃ uppīḷetvā aṭṭhāsi. maṇḍūko'pi daṇḍe ṭhapite'pi uppīḷite'pi dhammagatena pasādena vissaramakaronto'va kālam'akāsi.

examples.text: taṃ eko vacchapālako daṇḍam'olubbha tiṭṭhanto tassa sīse sannirumbhitvā aṭṭhāsi. so tāva'd'eva kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsabhavane dvādasayojanike kanakavimāne nibbatti.

86043.meaning1: having blocked; having impeded; having prevented
86043.meaningLit: having caused to obstruct down together

examples.text: tato uggatena ca gandhena uggāro'pi mukham'pi duggandhaṃ pūtikuṇapasadisaṃ hoti, so ca puriso apehi duggandhaṃ vāyasī'ti vattabbataṃ āpajjati, yañ'ca abhivaḍḍhitaṃ bahalattam'āpannaṃ paṭikujjanaphalakam'iva vaccakuṭiyā udarapaṭalabbhantare eva kuṇapagandhaṃ sannirumbhitvā tiṭṭhati.
ye pana tasmiṃ titthe nimujjaneneva pāpasuddhi hotī'ti evaṃdiṭṭhikā, te tattha nimujjitvā assāse sannirumbhitvā maruppapātapatitā viya tatth'eva jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇanti.

86044.meaning1: having relished; having enjoyed; having taken pleasure (in)

examples.text: muttassāde attano dhammatāya mutte ṭhānā cute asucimhi pacchā assādentassa vinā upakkamena muccati, anāpatti. sace assādetvā puna mocan'atthāya nimitte upakkamitvā moceti, saṅgh'ādiseso.

tathā hi khaluṅko asso damathaṃ na upeti ito c'ito ca yathāruci dhāvati, evam'evaṃ yo puthujjano abhiññālābhī, so abhiññā assādetvā alam'ettāvatā, katam'ettāvatā'ti uttaridamathāya aparisakkanto abhiññācittavasena ito c'ito ca dhāvati pavattati, so assakhaluṅko jhāyī'ti vutto.
tatr'āyaṃ vacan'attho, tapantī'ti tapā, akusaladhammānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ. te tape assi nirassi pahāsi viddhaṃsī'ti tapassī.

ātappaṃ vuccati vīriyaṃ. yo cetasiko vīriy'ārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo ṭhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittacchandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggaho vīriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo.
dutiyassa vāde tath'eva kaṭito muccitvā dakasotaṃ otiṇṇamatte, tatiyassa vāde tath'eva sakalakāyaṃ saṅkhobhetvā tato muccitvā dakasotaṃ otiṇṇamatte bahi nikkhante vā anikkhante vā saṅgh'ādiseso.

86049.meaning1: name of a man in a Petavatthu story
86049.commentary: (PVa) kesavā'ti so kira kesānaṃ sobhanānaṃ atthitāya kesavo'ti voharīyati. tena naṃ nāmena ālapati.

examples.text: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, rohiṇeyyassa kesavo, taramānarūpo vuṭṭhāsi, bhātusokena aṭṭito.
yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānan'ti yo cetasiko vīriy'ārambho sammāvāyāmo'ti evaṃ ayaṃ duko vibhatto.

86051.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ava + hara + nta
86051.synonym: āharayamāna, āhārayanta, gilanta, paribhuñjanta, bhuñjanta, bhuñjamāna

examples.text: yaṃ yāmakālik'ādīsu ajjhohāre ajjhohāre dukkaṭaṃ, taṃ asaṃsaṭṭhavasena vuttaṃ. sace pana āmisasaṃsaṭṭhāni honti, āhār'atthāya'pi anāhār'atthāya'pi paṭiggahetvā ajjhoharantassa pācittiyam'eva.

sace koci vuḍḍhapabbajito vassāni agaṇetvā pāḷiyam'pi aṭṭhatvā ekapassen'āgantvā mahāpeḷ'ādīsu kaṭacchunā ukkhitte bhattapiṇḍe pattaṃ upanāmetvā seno viya maṃsapesiṃ gahetvā gacchati, theyyasaṃvāsako na hoti. bhikkhuvassāni pana gaṇetvā gaṇhanto theyyasaṃvāsako hoti.
yadā vipassī lok'aggo, āyusaṅkhāram'ossaji, pathavī sampakampittha, medanī jalamekhalā.

so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā saddhaṃ paṭilabhati. tattha yā vīmaṃsā ussāhanā tulanā upaparikkhā, ayaṃ sutamayī paññā. tathā sutena nissayena yā vīmaṃsā tulanā upaparikkhā manasānupekkhaṇā, ayaṃ cintāmayī paññā.

86055.meaning1: developed by thinking; speculative; theoretical; imaginary
86055.commentary: (NPa) tathā'ti yathā sutamayī paññā vīmaṃsādipariyāyavatī vīmaṃsādivibhāgavatī ca, tathā cintāmayī cā'ti attho. yathā vā sutamayī oramattikā anavaṭṭhitā ca, evaṃ cintāmayī cā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā saddhaṃ paṭilabhati. tattha yā vīmaṃsā ussāhanā tulanā upaparikkhā, ayaṃ sutamayī paññā. tathā sutena nissayena yā vīmaṃsā tulanā upaparikkhā manasānupekkhaṇā, ayaṃ cintāmayī paññā.

86056.meaning1: developed by meditation; accomplished by meditation; experiential
86056.commentary: (NPa) yaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjatī'ti vuttanayena manasikārappayogena diṭṭhivisuddhi-kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi-maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhi-paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhīnaṃ sampa ādanena vipassanaṃ ussukkantassa yaṃ ñāṇadassanavisuddhisaṅkhātaṃ ariyamaggañāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ bhāvanāmayī paññā'ti sambandho.

examples.text: tathā sutena nissayena yā vīmaṃsā tulanā upaparikkhā manas'ānupekkhaṇā, ayaṃ cintāmayī paññā. imāhi dvīhi paññāhi manasikārasampayuttassa yaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati dassanabhūmiyaṃ vā bhāvanābhūmiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ bhāvanāmayī paññā.
evam'imāya gāthāya puññ'ānubhāvena labhitabbaṃ rajjasampattito oraṃ devamanussasampattiṃ dassetvā idāni tadubhayarajjasampattiṃ dassento padesarajjan'ti imaṃ gātham'āha.

86058.meaning1: having become fully ordained; having taken higher ordination

examples.text: āyasmā hi soṇo pabbajitvāva therassa santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā ghaṭento vāyamanto anupasampanno'va sot'āpanno hutvā upasampajjitvā upāsakā'pi sot'āpannā honti, aham'pi sot'āpanno, kim'ettha cittan'ti uparimagg'atthāya vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā antovasse'y'eva chaḷabhiñño hutvā visuddhipavāraṇāya pavāresi.

86059.meaning1: having propped up; having supported; having reinforced

examples.text: ekacco akusalaṃ katvā duggatibhave nibbattati. so tattha ṭhito punappunaṃ akusalaṃ katvā taṃ kammaṃ upatthambhetvā bahūni vassasatasahassāni duggatibhavasmiṃ'y'eva vicarati.

86063.meaning1: to disturb; to upset; to destroy

examples.text: piṭṭhipāsāṇe sukhumarajaṃ hoti, deve phusāyante allīyati, tam'pi cātumāsaccayena vikopetuṃ na vaṭṭati. sace pana akatapabbhāre vammiko uṭṭhito hoti, yathāsukhaṃ vikopetuṃ vaṭṭati. sace abbhokāse uṭṭhahati, omakacātumāsaṃ ovaṭṭho'y'eva vaṭṭati.

86064.meaning1: name of a Brahman in a Jātaka story; former birth of Devadatta

examples.text: rājāsi luddakammo, ekarājā pupphavatīyā, so pucchi brahmabandhuṃ, khaṇḍahālaṃ purohitaṃ mūḷhaṃ.

86065.meaning1: name of a snake-charmer in a Jātaka story

examples.text: taṃ sutvā nesādabrāhmaṇo cintesi ayaṃ alampāyano yv'āssa nāgaṃ dasseti, tassa maṇiratanaṃ dassati, bhūridattamassa dassetvā maṇiṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti.

nesādabrāhmaṇo'pi bho alampāyana, imaṃ nāgaṃ gaṇha, maṇiṃ me dehī'ti āha. alampāyano nāgaṃ disvā tuṭṭho maṇiṃ kismiñci agaṇetvā gaṇha, brāhmaṇā'ti hatthe khipi. so tassa hatthato bhassitvā pathaviyaṃ patitamatto'va pathaviṃ pavisitvā nāgabhavanam'eva gato.

86066.meaning1: is said; is spoken; is told

examples.text: chaṭṭhe nāmagottaṃ na jīratī'ti atītabuddhānaṃ yāv'ajjadivasā nāmagottaṃ kathiyati, tasmā na jīratī'ti vuccati. porāṇā pana addhāne gacchante na paññāyissati, jīraṇasabhāvo pana na hoti'y'evā'ti vadanti.

86067.grammar: abs of pasaveti, irreg form of pasavetvā, caus, trans (+acc)
86067.meaning1: having generated; having produced; having created

examples.text: te pāpadhammā pasavetva pāpaṃ, kāyassa bhedā nirayaṃ vajanti, ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, tasmā isayo nappasaṃsanti kāme.

86068.meaning1: having generated; having produced; having created

yuddhabhūmiyaṃ patitaṃ asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā tomaraṃ vā disvā pāsāṇena vā kenaci vā asiṃ bhinditvā satthak'atthāya gahetuṃ vaṭṭati, itarāni'pi viyojetvā kiñci satthak'atthāya gahetuṃ vaṭṭati kiñci kattaradaṇḍ'ādi-atthāya.

86080.commentary: (VAt) kathinaṃ attharāpetvā'ti sakāritavacanena tehi bāhirato āgatattherehi sayaṃ kathinaṃ na attharitabbaṃ, sabbapubbakicc'ādikaṃ saṃvidahitvā te purimikāya vass'ūpagatā antosīmaṭṭhabhikkhū'y'eva attharāpetabbā'ti dasseti, aññathā añño kathinaṃ attharati, añño ānisaṃsaṃ labhatī'ti āpajjati, na panevaṃ yujjati. vakkhati hi ānisaṃso pana itaresaṃ'y'eva hotī'ti.

examples.text: sace purimikāya upagatā kathin'atthārakusalā na honti, atthārakusalā khandhakabhāṇakatherā pariyesitvā ānetabbā. kammavācaṃ sāvetvā kathinaṃ attharāpetvā dānañ'ca bhuñjitvā gamissanti. ānisaṃso pana itaresaṃ'y'eva hoti.

86081.meaning1: fifteenth day of the lunar fortnight

examples.text: cātuddasikā ca pannarasikā cā'ti ettha cātuddasikāya ajja pavāraṇā cātuddasī'ti evaṃ pubbakiccaṃ kātabbaṃ, pannarasikāya ajja pavāraṇā pannarasī'ti.
laṅkāyaṃ doṇinagare, vasatā doṇināminā, mahātherena lekhitvā, suṭṭhapitaṃ yathāsutaṃ.

86083.commentary: (SaDM) āsa upavesane. upavesanaṃ nisīdanaṃ āsane upaviṭṭho saṅgho'ti ettha viya. āsati. acchati. āsīno. āsanaṃ. upāsati. upāsako.

examples.text: na hi bhavaṃ gotamo … āsanena vā nimantetī'ti evaṃ attanā sutaṃ diṭṭhena nigametvā nindanto āha, ta'y'idaṃ bho gotama na sampannam'evā'ti taṃ abhivādan'ādīnaṃ akaraṇaṃ na yuttam'eva.

86085.meaning1: is sought; is looked for; is searched for

examples.text: kilese mārento gacchati, maggati vā nibbānaṃ, maggīyati vā nibbān'atthikehi, gammati vā tehi paṭipajjīyatī'ti maggo.

86086.meaning1: having good luck; possessing good fortune

examples.text: bhagī bhajī bhāgī vibhattavā iti, akāsi bhagganti garū'ti bhāgyavā, bahūhi ñāyehi subhāvit'attano, bhavantago so bhagavā'ti vuccatī'ti.
gaṇassa sussūsatī'ti gaṇo assa vacanaṃ sussūsati suṇāti upalakkheti. sotaṃ odahatī'ti sotu'kāmatāya sotaṃ avadahati patiṭṭhāpeti.

86088.meaning1: to say; to tell; to explain (something to)

examples.text: na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ, atthaṃ dhammañ'ca pucchito, bhadrakāro ca me putto, oraso mama atrajo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca, gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇa.
evaṃ anantāni cakkavāḷāni anantā lokadhātuyo bhagavā anantena buddhañāṇena avedi, aññāsi, paṭivijjhi. evam'assa okāsaloko'pi sabbathā vidito.

86090.meaning1: having made ask; having made enquire (about)

examples.text: te pucchiṃsu, bhagavā pucchitapucchitaṃ kathesi. na kevalaṃ macchānaṃ'y'eva, tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe rukkhānam'pi pabbatapāde dvipadacatuppadasakuṇānam'pi nāmāni pucchāpetvā kathesi.

86091.commentary: (JAa) sabb'itthiyo'ti ṭhapetvā vipassanāya tanukatakilesā sesā sabbā itthiyo pāpaṃ kareyyuṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ ve disvā kaṇḍarīkinnarānaṃ, sabb'itthiyo na ramanti agāre, taṃ tādisaṃ maccaṃ cajitvā bhariyā, aññaṃ disvā purisaṃ pīṭhasappiṃ.
yadā vipassī lok'aggo, āyusaṅkhāram'ossaji, pathavī sampakampittha, medanī jalamekhalā.
ath'ekadivasaṃ eko kammamutto jaraggavo divā gocare caritvā rattiṃ tasmiṃ susāne pupphagumbe sīsaṃ katvā romanthayamāno aṭṭhāsi.
